intro: Vietnam is a one-party communist state led by the Communist Party of Vietnam.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The party's general secretary is the most powerful leader. The president is head of state and the prime minister runs the government. The National Assembly passes laws; nearly all members belong to the party.
Opposition parties are not allowed and the media is controlled by the state.

chapters.title: Vietnam and the world
text: Vietnam joined ASEAN in 1995 and the WTO in 2007. It keeps close ties with China but also disputes islands in the South China Sea with it.

keyTerms.meaning: A country where only one political party is allowed to rule.
The Association of Southeast Asian Nations.
